limits: Manual boundaries on one orthophoto, not cadastral or on-site survey.
Map acquisition date unknown; not a verified current obstacle layout.
Density is a chosen capacity parameter, not an observation.
10% and 20% deductions are sensitivity assumptions, not measured infrastructure.
No evacuation, circulation or permit capacity verified.
Gross capacity assumes the whole selected footprint is available; not all vegetation, furniture or temporary objects individually mapped.
Capacity is not evidence of actual turnout on 2026-11-15.
